historical_reviews.deepseek: Uses memory EDAC patterns for an OCP/PCIe AER test and does not establish which OCP function or network path was targeted.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds OCP mapping but does not explicitly protect the management/data path or create a mandatory oracle when management logs are optional.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Row 30 covers general PCIe slots; row 33 covers OCP UCE. OCP connectivity and severity make this CE variant independently testable.

original_test_intent: Inject one correctable PCIe error into every approved OCP slot/root port and prove the expected AER/WHEA CE occurs while the OCP device, network link and system remain operational and fault indicators stay off.
original_method: Map each OCP physical slot and function through endpoint/root-port BDF to the Cscript socket/port, identify management and active traffic dependencies, quiesce or select a safe test window, perform one CE injection, and correlate Cscript/Windows PCIe evidence with link, traffic, driver and applicable management logs before restoration.
manual_activity: The operator approves OCP identity and maintenance window, protects an independent management path, changes BIOS controls, performs one injection and restores settings. The agent may validate topology and collect connectivity/AER evidence.
required_inputs: OCP slot/function to endpoint/root-port BDF and Cscript socket/port map
OCP NIC/device PN/FW/driver, interface/bond/route/VLAN and management-path dependency
Mandatory Windows PCIe CE plus link/traffic/device-health and applicable BMC/UEFI oracle
OOB console, abort, recovery and BIOS restoration plan
safety_requirements: Prove an independent management path before any OCP target action
Quiesce production traffic or approve a bounded maintenance window
Use a fresh topology map and inject one approved function/root port
Abort on connectivity loss, link retrain/down, device reset, fatal escalation or wrong target
No retry; restore settings and verify routes/bonds/link/traffic
agent_execution_scope: Validate OCP/BDF/port/network mapping and collect read-only AER, driver, link, traffic, BMC/UEFI evidence
Do not select a port, disrupt routing, change BIOS, inject, reset/retry or set verdict
engineer_actions: Approve OCP function coverage and safe path
Define connectivity/AER and optional management-log acceptance

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Memory EDAC keywords do not prove OCP PCIe CE, and host SSH may vanish if the targeted OCP interface carries management; Windows evidence is also unresolved.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Execute only after mapping the exact OCP endpoint/root port and proving the agent is not dependent on that path. Use Windows WHEA/AER and independent traffic observation as core evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: OCP slot 1~N, CE severity, topology/port-map sequence and 15/5-minute estimates are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Snapshot OCP inventory, BDF hierarchy, link speed/width, interface/route/bond state and controlled traffic; inject one mapped root port; correlate PCIe CE while proving no packet/link/device/service degradation; restore and diff state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds the OCP-specific network and management-path safety/coverage missing from a generic PCIe test.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A generic corrected event cannot prove the intended OCP function or that connectivity remained healthy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong OCP root port can disconnect the agent, disturb production traffic, reset a NIC or affect multiple logical interfaces.

project_override_considerations: OCP commonly carries network and sometimes management traffic. Never infer that a target is safe or non-management; require route/interface evidence and OOB recovery.
expected_evidence: OCP slot/function/endpoint/root-port/Cscript mapping and owner approval
NIC/device identity, FW/driver and network-path precheck
Package hash and full topology/injection transcript
Windows PCIe CE, unchanged link/driver/traffic/routes and applicable BMC/UEFI records
Front-panel off, restored configuration and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: OCP slot 1~N lacks function/BDF/socket/port coverage and network/management-path identity; BMC/UEFI are optional without a mandatory PCIe oracle; Windows conflicts with dmesg; and DeepSeek substitutes memory EDAC patterns for OCP AER evidence.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 31 Wistron-System RAS-00751-V003: approve OCP slot/function to endpoint/root-port BDF and Cscript socket/port coverage, OCP PN/FW/driver plus interface/bond/route/VLAN and management-path constraints, ITP/CScripts version/hash/CE semantics, mandatory Windows PCIe CE and connectivity oracle, OOB recovery and BIOS restoration.

review_improvement: Adds the OCP-specific management and traffic blast radius, so a correctable event on an unrelated port—or one that silently disconnects the test path—cannot count.
independent_technical_reasoning: An OCP slot is not just another label for a generic PCIe endpoint: it commonly hosts NIC functions that may carry the test agent or management traffic. The injection target therefore requires a chain from physical slot and function through BDF/root port to Cscript port, plus proof of an independent observation path. Windows PCIe AER/WHEA and unchanged connectivity form the mandatory core because BMC/UEFI logging is optional. These conditions can be provided by the platform owner, supporting RPUC rather than BLOCKED.
